en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, elegant 19th‑century mansion or institutional building facing a broad street. The structure has a mansard roof with dormer windows, tall rectangular windows on the façade, and a small garden with a fence in front. Several pedestrians and a dog are visible on the sidewalk. Below the image, printed text reads "Nijmegen — R. K. Universiteit".
